name_zh: 阿本斯/危地马拉/土地/联合果品/CIA/切/哈科沃/政变/900号

description_zh: 雅科沃·阿本斯（1913-1971），危地马拉前总统，1951-1954年在位。他是一位危地马拉政治家，前农场主，通过实施土地改革和没收联合果品公司的土地，引发了联合果品公司的不满和美国的干预。1954年，美国支持的叛乱部队推翻了阿本斯政府，阿本斯流亡国外。他的统治时期，危地马拉实施了土地改革，但也引发了跨国公司的干预和美国的入侵。
description_en: Jacobo Arbenz (1913-1971), former President of Guatemala, served from 1951 to 1954. He was a Guatemalan politician and former farmer, implemented land reform and confiscated United Fruit Company land, causing United Fruit Company dissatisfaction and US intervention. In 1954, US-supported rebel forces overthrew the Arbenz government, and Arbenz fled abroad. During his rule, Guatemala implemented land reform, but also provoked multinational corporate intervention and US invasion.
